protocol_checks.vulnerability_mechanism: Confirmed. At v6.3.20 the shared gorilla/websocket Upgrader explicitly returns true from CheckOrigin, overriding gorilla/websocket's nil-CheckOrigin same-origin default. The /api/logs, /api/enter, and /api/command handlers all use that Upgrader on the UI server's default port 8090, enabling a malicious web origin to reach pod logs, an interactive pod shell, and pipeline commands.
protocol_checks.atomic_bic: Confirmed as 764fefcd27f740c7ca931a4b8079325ab1b9de19. Its focused diff first changes `websocket.Upgrader{}` to the always-true CheckOrigin; blame at v6.3.20 assigns the vulnerable block to this commit. It has exactly one parent and is neither a merge, move, revert, nor release aggregate.
protocol_checks.immediate_parent_absence: Confirmed. Immediate parent 19978db79a119a0e41007f91203784f88e537363 has `var upgrader = websocket.Upgrader{}` and no CheckOrigin occurrence under pkg/devspace/server; the vendored library therefore applies checkSameOrigin.
protocol_checks.squash_member_decomposition: Confirmed. The all-history search also finds parentless full-tree snapshot 70a38fa33874413b25c3c5589479015057b3f2c3 in 2020, but merge f0f0a2808e496c0d6bd2f39de2aa1e44c07806a9 joins it with b887ccc709044f745ad79e8fd7ff59a820d2447f, and both parents already contain the same vulnerable block. The second parent descends from 764fefcd, so the surviving finer public first-write is reconstructible and the snapshot/merge is not a BIC. No decomposition of 764fefcd is required.
protocol_checks.affected_and_fixed_release_membership: Confirmed. 764fefcd is an ancestor of both v6.3.20 (a91772ba91f0b8c8cac08e83580a8202dfe00746) and v6.3.21 (7f272dcf90653fa9b42bc4347f7f3f9a52b0e8b5). Fix 6b5073d5c38cb3a41b5cb35c5e979c2516cf688e is not an ancestor of v6.3.20 and is an ancestor of v6.3.21. The tagged files respectively retain the always-true check and contain the localhost/127.0.0.1 restriction. CVE-2026-42283 is PUBLISHED and records versions before 6.3.21 as affected; the vendor advisory page is live and the frozen GHSA record is not withdrawn.
protocol_checks.direct_fix_or_unpatched_state: Confirmed direct fix 6b5073d5c38cb3a41b5cb35c5e979c2516cf688e. It replaces the always-true predicate with Origin parsing restricted to localhost or 127.0.0.1 (while permitting absent Origin for non-browser clients) and adds focused CheckOrigin tests.
protocol_checks.bic_only_ai_attribution: Confirmed NOT_AI from the BIC alone. The 2019 commit object names human author and committer fabiankramm <kramm@covexo.com>, has subject `Add xterm`, an empty body, and no co-author, generator, AI-tool, or bot marker. Later commits and the 2026 remediation were not used for AI attribution.

findings: The primary record identifies the correct CSWSH mechanism, atomic introducer, immediate parent, vulnerable and fixed release boundary, and direct remediation.
